dogecoin.text: Not sure I have ever seen a price-sentiment disconnect like the one visible in this Google Trends chart on dogecoin. https://t.co/Oc3OobZaLz
FWIW - The behavioral parallels between GME and dogecoin are remarkable.

The true beauty of dogecoin is its ability to show in real-time how, at extremes in sentiment, we can believe that anything can be an investment.

And at the very extreme, the wildest ideas seem to suddenly show up and capture the crowd with their prices rocketing higher.
Dogecoin is the new Tokyo real estate. https://t.co/68YzsWGD11
Imagining Tesla earnings had the company bought Dogecoin instead...

What is most popular has always been sold in meme-form.

Crowds don't buy dull, complexity-laden facts, they crave the simplest perception-fueled adjectives.

Crowds pick investments like they do movies, music and fashion: resonance.

Don't condemn Dogecoin; learn from it.
